text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! Trainer, you're 
really good at this.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I will definitely repay your kindness 
today! I'll have Dia-chan teach me and do 
tons of practice!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'll bring plenty along! Make sure you 
clear some space for the Paka Pouchies, 
okay? ♪
